snippet.title: Playable Archive - Out Now on Steam for FREE
snippet.description:
From the creator of The Mortuary Assistant comes a new micro horror experience on steam for free! https://store.steampowered.com/app/5356470/Playable_Archive

I spent a long time working on a new project after Mortuary Assistant. When that project was canceled it sat on the shelf collecting dust. However, the fine people at DreadXP asked me if I would be interested in taking its unfinished form and packaging it as a full experience so it would not be lost to the sands of time. I agreed.

Playable Archive is the polished pieces of my previous project. There was still much that had to be left on the cutting room floor, but I am happy to be releasing it for people to experience. I hope you enjoy it!

New projects are in the works now that the dust has settled.
